datasheet_identity.title: SI2309CDS 60V P-Channel Power MOSFET

extraction_notes: The supplied manufacturer PDF identifies SI2309CDS as a 60V P-Channel Power MOSFET from TECH PUBLIC; no document revision or date is stated in the PDF.
P-channel voltage and current values are stored as positive magnitudes where represented numerically; signed source conditions are retained in condition strings.
The VGS(th) table publishes separate MIN = -1.4 V, TYP = -2.0 V, and MAX = -2.6 V values at VDS = VGS and ID = -250 uA.
The RDS(on) table publishes both typical and maximum values at VGS = -10 V and -4.5 V, each at ID = -1.5 A; all four rows are retained as separate points.
The capacitance table publishes Ciss = 444.2 pF, Coss = 19.6 pF, and Crss = 17.9 pF at VDS = -30 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1 MHz; values are converted to SI units.

Additional table values not representable by the strict schema are IDSS MAX = -1 uA at VDS = -60 V and VGS = 0 V; IGSS MAX = +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-20 V and VDS = 0 V; gfs TYP = 3 S at VDS = -5 V and ID = -1.5 A; t_d(on) TYP = 40 ns, t_r TYP = 35 ns, t_d(off) TYP = 15 ns, and t_f TYP = 10 ns at VDD = -30 V, ID = -1.5 A, VGS = -10 V, RG = 3 ohm; Qg TYP = 11.3 nC, Qgs TYP = 2.7 nC, and Qgd TYP = 1.6 nC under the same gate-charge conditions; trr TYP = 25 ns at TJ = 25 degC and IF = -1.5 A; Qrr TYP = 31 nC at di/dt = -100 A/us; and RthetaJA MAX = 83.3 degC/W.

Figures 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, and 7 contain readable manufacturer curves. Curve points are conservative direct readings from visible grid locations only; no points were interpolated or extrapolated beyond the plotted traces.
